claim.claim-text: a transmitting and receiving section (203) configured to receive, via higher layer signalling, a physical uplink control channel, PUCCH, resource configuration and to transmit PUCCH, said PUCCH resource configuration comprising: a parameter indicating that intra-slot frequency hopping is enabled, a parameter indicating a starting physical resource block, PRB, that is a first PRB in a first hop, and a parameter indicating a second hop PRB that is a first PRB in a second hop; said terminal (20) further comprising:

a control section (401) configured to control transmission of said PUCCH and to use, in a case where the second hop PRB is equal to the starting PRB in a frequency direction, different base sequences for transmitting said PUCCH between the first hop and the second hop.

2. The terminal (20) according to claim 1, wherein even when the second hop PRB is equal to the starting PRB in the frequency direction, then the control section (401) is configured to use, in PUCCH format 1, an orthogonal sequence having a length that differs depending on whether the PUCCH resource configuration indicates that the frequency hopping is enabled.

3. The terminal (20) according to claim 1 or 2, wherein even when the second hop PRB is equal to the starting PRB in the frequency direction, the control section (401) is configured to determine a position of a demodulation reference signal for PUCCH format 3 or 4 based on whether the PUCCH resource configuration indicates that the frequency hopping is enabled.

4. The terminal (20) according to any one of claims 1 through 3, wherein the control section (401) is configured to use each base sequence for at least one of an uplink control information and a demodulation reference signal.

5. The terminal (20) according to any one of claims 1 through 4, wherein at least one of an uplink control information and a demodulation reference signal uses a low-peak to average power ratio (low-PAPR) sequence.
6. A radio communication method for a terminal comprising:

receiving, via higher layer signalling, a physical uplink control channel, PUCCH, resource configuration comprising: a parameter indicating that intra-slot frequency hopping is enabled, a parameter indicating a starting physical resource block, PRB, that is a first PRB in a first hop, and a parameter indicating a second hop PRB that is a first PRB in a second hop; and
using, in a case where the second hop PRB is equal to the starting PRB in a frequency direction, different base sequences for transmitting a PUCCH between the first hop and the second hop.

a transmitting and receiving section (103) configured to transmit, via higher layer signalling, a physical uplink control channel, PUCCH, resource configuration and to receive a PUCCH, said PUCCH resource configuration comprising: a parameter indicating that intra-slot frequency hopping is enabled, a parameter indicating a starting physical resource block, PRB, that is a first PRB in a first hop, and a parameter indicating a second hop PRB that is a first PRB in a second hop; said base station (10) further comprising:

a control section (301) configured to control reception of said PUCCH and to use, in a case where the second hop PRB is equal to the starting PRB in a frequency direction, different base sequences for receiving said PUCCH between the first hop and the second hop.
8. A system (1) comprising a terminal (20) according to any one of claims 1 to 5, and a base station (10) according to claim 7.
